findings.evidence: Home 'Bébé cette semaine' shows the week-32 baby weight as '1.7 g' (07 DOM: '42.4 cm | Taille | 1.7 g | Poids'; also 26/32/35/45/55, and '1.7 غ' in ar 49). A 32-week fetus weighs about 1.7 kg. src/data/weeks_db.json stores kilograms in the gram field for every week from 28 to 40 (:897 '"baby_weight_g": 1' at W28 … :1281 '3.4' at W40), and HomeScreen.tsx:690 renders formatMeasure(weekData.baby_weight_g, 'g'). So every third-trimester user sees '1 g' … '3.4 g' on the main screen. Week 25 (store screenshot) correctly shows '660 g', which makes the unit break at W28 visible when paging weeks.
findings.fix_hint: src/data/weeks_db.json weeks 28-40: multiply baby_weight_g by 1000 (1000, 1150, 1300, 1500, 1700, 1900, 2100, 2400, 2600, 2900, 3100, 3300, 3400). Also fix the Firestore 'weeks' seed if it is imported from this file. Optionally have formatMeasure switch to kg when ≥1000 g. Add a unit test asserting baby_weight_g is non-decreasing across weeks.

findings.evidence: Two surfaces give the same 'your baby now' fact with different numbers. Home (07) for week 32: '🥒 … 42.4 cm … Votre bébé fait la taille d'un(e) Concombre (42,4 cm)'. BabyEvolution (23), on the card badged '📍 Vous êtes ici' / 'Mois 8 / Semaines 32-35': '🍍 Ananas 32cm'. That is a 10 cm gap and a different fruit for the same user at the same moment. The source is src/config/babyGrowthData.ts:179 size '32cm' (crown-rump-style series: M6 20cm, M7 26cm, M9 48cm) against weeks_db.json crown-heel (W32 42.4). The weekly data also contradicts itself at W16: weeks_db.json:512 '"baby_size_cm": 16' but label 'Avocat (11,6 cm)', and W17 is 13 cm, so Home shows '16 cm' next to '(11,6 cm)'.
findings.fix_hint: Pick one convention (crown-heel from W21, as weeks_db does). Derive babyGrowthData month sizes from weeks_db (e.g. month 8 = W32-35 → 42-46 cm) or drop the size from the month card. Fix weeks_db.json:512 to 11.6. Add a consistency test: monthCard(size) ∈ [min, max] of its weeks.

findings.evidence: The same gestational age is stated in two dating conventions that disagree by about 3 weeks. Onboarding step 2 (05) computes from LMP: 'Vous seriez à la Semaine 32 / Soit 31 SA + 1 jours' (week index = amenorrhoea weeks). Home 'Votre Corps' for that same week 32 (07 DOM) says 'À 32 semaines de grossesse (34 SA), vous entrez dans la dernière ligne droite'. The error is systematic in weeks_db.json mom_body_text_fr/ar/en/tn: W7 '(9 SA)', W8 '(10 SA)', W20 '(22 SA)', W32 '(34 SA)'. A user told she is 31 SA on one screen reads 34 SA on the next, and Hospital Bag advises 'vers 32-34 SA' (fr/cycle8.json:61). Also 'Soit 31 SA + 1 jours': wrong plural (fr/onboarding.json:34 'saDays').
findings.fix_hint: src/data/weeks_db.json: the app's 'Semaine N' is LMP-based, so rewrite the '(N+2 SA)' parentheticals to '(N-1 SA révolues)' or remove them in all 4 locales. Have a clinician confirm (F-013). fr/onboarding.json:34: add an i18next plural (_one/_other) for 'jour(s)'.

findings.evidence: The month-8 fetus illustration has fake UI baked into the bitmap: a '<' back button top-left, TWO share icons (top-right and bottom-right) and a round bean icon bottom-left (zoom of 23 at 88,277-288,477; also visible on Home 07/26/32/45/55). None of them are controls: 23-se-baby-evolution.a11y.json lists no interactive element inside the image. Every user at weeks ~29-35 (and any reviewer on a week-32 demo account) sees dead share/back buttons on the main Home card. assets/images/baby-3d/month-4.png is worse: it is a photo of an iPad in a hospital room with the fetus on its screen, a device mock-up rather than an illustration. A reviewer who taps a share glyph gets nothing (Guideline 2.1 / 4.0).
findings.fix_hint: Regenerate or clean assets/images/baby-3d/month-8.png and month-4.png (referenced at src/config/babyGrowthData.ts:175 and :91). Add a visual check to the asset pipeline (manual contact sheet of all 9).

findings.evidence: At 375x667 week view with an empty day (08, also 47), the FAB '+' (299,542 56x56) sits on the empty-state copy: it covers the end of 'Aucun événement pour ce jour' and the 💆‍♀️ emoji of 'Profitez-en pour vous reposer !' findings.evidence: The bottom tab labels lose their descenders at every phone width. At 10x zoom 'Rappels' reads 'Raooels' at 375x667 (07) and at 390x844 (55), with white space below the glyphs, so the label's own line box clips them (the viewport does not). layout.tablist.tabs[].truncated is false because descender overflow does not change scrollHeight. The ar labels ('التذكيرات', 'الرئيسية') are cut the same way. It is probably web-only, but store screenshots are produced from the web export (scripts/capture-store-screenshots.ts:7-10), so the clipped labels ship to the App Store and Play listings.
findings.fix_hint: App.tsx:256 screenOptions: add tabBarLabelStyle { lineHeight: 14, paddingBottom: 2 } (or fontSize 11 + lineHeight 14) and verify on an iOS simulator. Probe (wave-E-a11y.ts:339-344): compare the text Range rect with the clipping ancestor instead of scrollHeight.

findings.evidence: Switch thumbs render teal #009688 on a pink track in Settings (20: 'Message quotidien') and AddAppointment reminders (40/46: 'La veille', 'Le jour J'). That is off-palette. The source asks for white (SettingsScreen.tsx:179 thumbColor white) and primary pink (AddAppointmentScreen.tsx:724/742/760). RN-web ignores thumbColor for the ON state and uses its default activeThumbColor #009688, so this is web-only (§0.3). It still matters because the store screenshot pipeline captures the web export (capture-store-screenshots.ts:7). The same holds for web-only date and placeholder rendering (A-020, A-024): what ships in the listing is not the native UI (Guideline 2.3.3).
findings.fix_hint: Pass activeThumbColor={same colour} alongside thumbColor on every <Switch> (web), or better, re-shoot store screenshots on a simulator (the script's own 'Honest limitation', :27-31) before submission.

findings.evidence: The trimester label uses a wrong word in ar/tn: Reminders header 'الأسبوع 32 • الفصل 3' ('season/chapter 3'). The source is ar/common.json:133 and tn/common.json:133 'trimesterLabel': 'الفصل {{trimester}}', and ar/tn profile.json:6 'trimester': 'الفصل'. Home says 'الثلث الثالث' (49), which is correct. French is inconsistent the same way: Home '3ème Trimestre' (fr/home.json:27 '{{trimester}} Trimestre' + weeks_db 'trimester':'3ème') against Reminders '3e trimestre' (11). '3e' is the correct French form.
findings.fix_hint: ar/tn common.json:133 → 'الثلث {{ordinal}}' with ordinals (الأول/الثاني/الثالث). ar/tn profile.json:6 → 'الثلث'. fr: make Home use the '3e trimestre' formatter instead of the weeks_db 'trimester' string.

findings.evidence: Offline, AddAppointment Save sits on a disabled 'Enregistrement...' with no message for as long as the device stays offline. 46 extra.afterSave: {stillOnForm:true, dialogs:[], liveRegions:[], spinner:0}, serverDocsWhileOffline:0. The Firestore write is queued: on reconnect it lands (47: synced:true, doc 'Offline E 2138') and the toast appears. This is not a false success, but a user in a clinic with no signal sees an endless 'Enregistrement...'. If she taps Annuler and re-creates the appointment, the queued first write still syncs and she gets a duplicate. The code is shared (the UI awaits the server ack), so native behaves the same. The helper also exempts 'Enregistrement...' from contrast (2.48) as 'disabled', but it is a status message.
findings.fix_hint: AddAppointmentScreen save handler: race the write against a 5 s timeout. On timeout, show 'Enregistré hors ligne, synchronisation à la reconnexion' and navigate back, since the Firestore cache keeps the pending write. Pass an idempotency id (doc id generated client-side before setDoc) so a retry cannot duplicate.

findings.evidence: At the 280x603 proxy, the AddAppointment Date field shows '2026-09-3': the value '2026-09-30' is cut and reads as 3 September. The title placeholder is cut too ('Ex: Échographie, Consultati'). The clipped-label probe only inspects text inside role=button/tab/link, never input values, so this was not flagged. On web the field is a TextInput (AddAppointmentScreen.tsx:583-589, web-harness §0.3). The native branch (:599-616) renders 'dd MMMM yyyy' ('30 septembre 2026') in the same half-width dateButton (styles:79-85, no numberOfLines/minHeight). At 375 with maxFontSizeMultiplier 1.4 that wraps to two lines and misaligns with the one-line time button.
findings.fix_hint: Native: format as 'dd MMM yyyy' ('30 sept. 2026') and set numberOfLines={1} adjustsFontSizeToFit, or stack Date/Time vertically below 360 pt. Probe: add input.scrollWidth > clientWidth for inputs with a value.

findings.evidence: The gradient contrast method overstates failures, and its documentation is stale. wave-E-a11y.ts:450-463 scores text against the WORST stop of the nearest gradient, not the colour at the text's position. 201 of 408 per-state non-disabled failures (49%) are gradient samples. Recomputed at the text's position (HEAD colours, same WCAG formula): Home 'Semaine 32' 28px/700 is reported 2.68 but is ≈4.7, a PASS at the large-text 3.0 (false positive). 'Choisir la langue' 28/700 is also ≈4.7 (false positive). The language subtitle is ≈4.48 against a reported 2.43. 'Créer un compte' is ≈4.0 at its centre against 2.68 (still a fail). The quick actions are ≈4.4-4.5 at their centre against 2.12 (borderline, and worse in the left column). '3ème Trimestre' is ≈3.1 against 1.9 (still a fail). Non-nearest gradients always use stops[0] (:445). summary.method.contrast says 'background-image in chain → indeterminate', which is what the code no longer does. The WCAG thresholds themselves are correct (large = ≥24px or ≥18.66px & ≥700; 4.5/3.0; sRGB 0.03928), and emoji-only strings are correctly skipped (\p{L}\p{N} filter :496).
findings.fix_hint: wave-E-a11y.ts measure(): read the expo-linear-gradient angle and stop positions, project the text rect centre (and its extremes) onto the gradient line, interpolate, and report the min over the text box. Keep 'worst stop' as a separate lowerBound field. Update summary.method.

findings.evidence: Covered layers are counted as visible, so overlap, contrast and target counts are inflated. 46-offline-add-appointment has 29 overlaps and 47-reconnect has 28, pairing Home controls ('Profil utilisateur', 'Semaine précédente') with Resources ('Compléments', 'Rechercher un article...') and AddAppointment ('Lieu (optionnel)'). Three screens are reported visible at once. The same applies to 45b (8) and 28 (7, the page under the modal scrim). The comment at wave-E-a11y.ts:325-326 promises an elementFromPoint 'top-most' check that is not implemented (:324-328 pushes unconditionally). The same is true of the nested-duplicate drop promised at :146-147. As a result 46 and 47 report 26 and 27 contrast failures that include texts from screens the user cannot see.
findings.fix_hint: wave-E-a11y.ts: filter every sample (interactive, overlap pair, contrast) with document.elementFromPoint at the rect centre; keep an element only if the hit node is inside it. Implement the ancestor-same-box dedupe. Re-run the roll-up and re-baseline E-005/E-006 counts.

findings.evidence: Previously visited tabs stay mounted. App.tsx:249 sets 'unmountOnBlur: true' under the comment 'P0-3 FIX … every visited tab stayed in the DOM → 3-4 simultaneous H1, stale ErrorBoundary, leaking Firestore listeners'. The installed @react-navigation/bottom-tabs is 7.8.11, which has no unmountOnBlur option (types.d.ts only has lazy / popToTopOnBlur), so the fix is a silent no-op. E-021 is the evidence: in 46/47 the Home and Resources tabs are still in the DOM, not aria-hidden, and exposed to the AX tree on web. On native, react-native-screens detaches the views, but the React trees and their Firestore onSnapshot listeners stay alive.
findings.fix_hint: App.tsx:249: remove unmountOnBlur. For the listeners, use useFocusEffect subscriptions, or popToTopOnBlur/freezeOnBlur where appropriate. Add a unit/e2e assertion that only one [role=heading][aria-level=1] exists after visiting 3 tabs.

findings.evidence: Four measurement blind spots, each hiding or inflating real defects. (1) False passes on placeholders: Register/Login placeholders measure 21:1 (03/04 a11y: fg #000000) because RN-web paints them black when placeholderTextColor is unset (RegisterScreen.tsx:195-221, LoginScreen, WeightTracker, AddTask, Health modal). On native iOS the default placeholder is ≈#C4C4C6 (≈1.7:1), so the funnel's most-used fields fail and are never measured. A-020 covers the web look. (2) hitSlop does not render on RN-web, so small44/below24 overstate native targets for 8 files (dots 10→26, eye toggles 49x21→69x41). (3) 'unnamed' counts Chromium's empty name for role-less divs: 20 of the 26 have visible text. (4) Clipping is measured only for text inside role=button/tab/link via scrollWidth/scrollHeight, which misses descender clipping (E-015) and input values (E-019).
findings.fix_hint: (1) Set placeholderTextColor explicitly everywhere (theme.colors.placeholder ≥4.5:1, e.g. #757575) so web and native agree, and have the probe flag a placeholder equal to the text colour. (2) Parse hitSlop from source/testID map or report 'native-effective' size separately. (3) Report roleless-with-text separately from nameless. (4) See E-015/E-019 probe hints.

findings.evidence: Spec coverage gaps. (a) The 'text-scale proxy' only narrows the layout. 280x603 @ deviceScaleFactor 1.4 (spec :527) leaves text and fixed boxes in the same proportion, so Dynamic Type overflow in fixed-height containers (tab bar 48, quick actions 48, chips, hour buttons) is never exercised. Welcome/Auth/Login/Calendar/Tasks were never captured at the proxy, and neither was the iPad Slide Over width (320 pt). Info.plist UISupportedInterfaceOrientations~ipad lists all 4 orientations with UIRequiresFullScreen=false, so multitasking widths are reachable. (b) Every signed-in state was reached by page.goto (spec :148-153), so no stack header ever shows its back button at 375 or 280, and header title/back truncation is unaudited. The deep link also mounts /article under the Home tab (App.tsx:363), so 17-se-article shows 'Accueil' active for a Resources article. (c) Plan row 28 asked for axe-core; a custom probe replaced it without disclosure in the summary.
findings.fix_hint: Add a real text-scale pass at 390x844 by injecting a 1.4x factor into every RN-web text node's font-size/line-height before measuring (or run on a simulator with Larger Text). Add 320x700 Slide Over states. Navigate in-app (tab tap, then push) for header states. Document the axe substitution in summary.method.

findings.evidence: (a) 49-ar-se-home.a11y.json is not valid JSON for strict parsers: jq fails with 'Invalid \\uXXXX\\uXXXX surrogate pair escape at line 349'. wave-E-a11y.ts:168 cuts outerHTML with .slice(0,220), which splits an emoji surrogate pair (the same risk exists in the text slices at :163, :474 and :778). (b) 07-se-home was captured before the 'Ma Journée 0/2' hero pill loaded. The pill is present in 26/32/35/49/55 but absent from the 07 DOM and a11y lists (45 is a different account), so the 375x667 Home layout with the pill was never audited.
findings.fix_hint: Use Array.from(str).slice(0,n).join('') (code-point safe) in every slice. In the spec, make the Home ready-marker wait for DailyRoutinesTracker (or its empty state) before snapState.

findings.evidence: The same title is repeated on several screens, which looks unfinished (worse on iPad). A stack header title is followed by an identical in-body H1 on Register (03 'Créer un compte' x2), Login (04), Kick counter (21), Hospital bag (22), Settings (20 'Paramètres' x2) and Health (14 'Ma Santé' + gradient '📊 Ma Santé'). Article (17) shows 'Article' in the header, then H1 'Les symptômes de grossesse', then H2 'Les symptômes de grossesse : comment les reconnaître'. A-003/GJ-008 track the related double back button.
findings.fix_hint: Set headerShown:false where the screen draws its own H1, or drop the in-body H1 and let the header carry the title. ArticleDetail: render H1 only once (skip the first markdown heading when it equals the title).

findings.evidence: Every article card in Resources (16, 45b) uses the same placeholder thumbnail: a flat #FF8FA3 block with one small 📚 emoji ('Les symptômes de grossesse', 'Préparation à l'accouchement', 'Différentes méthodes…', 'La péridurale'). findings.evidence: The Calendar empty state uses the 📅 emoji, which Apple's glyph always renders as 'JUL 17'. Under 'Septembre 2026 / Mer 30' it reads as a wrong date (08, 27, 47, 50, 54). The onboarding step 2 hero (05) has the same issue.

(b) In the Kick counter (44) the destructive 'Annuler' (discard session) uses the same filled magenta style as the primary 'Terminer la session'.

findings.evidence: High-impact contrast failures that are NOT on E-005's known list (flat colours, so these ratios are exact). Auth inline errors '⚠️ L'email est requis' / '⚠️ Email ou mot de passe incorrect': #E57373 on #FEEEEE = 2.66 (41/42). This is the one message a failing user must read. Onboarding step 4 email/password placeholders: #999 on white = 2.85 (06). Reminders/Tasks inactive top tab 'Tâches' / 'Rappels': #999 = 2.85 (11/12/53), i.e. navigation. Home baby stats '42.4 cm' / '1.7 g': coral #FF7F50 = 2.5 at 22px/800 (large, needs 3.0), on the Home card every user sees. Profile due date '02 décembre 2026': #F57C00 on #FFF8E1 = 2.55 at 20px/700 (not large). Health 'Objectif : 3,5 – 5,5 mmol/L (à jeun)': #999 = 2.85, a medical target. Auth 'Vos données ne seront pas sauvegardées sans compte': #999 on #FFF0F5 = 2.58 at 11px (the privacy caveat). Hydration '0%': #81C784 = 2.01. Secondary textLight #8D6E63 on the pink screen background #FFF5F8 = 4.33 across 18 states, including the kick-counter medical disclaimer 'Cet outil est informatif…' and the Hospital Bag / AddAppointment helpers.
